title: Seva Dal and NSUI hold candle marches in Delhi demanding justice for Ankita Bhandari
seoTitle: Delhi candle marches for Ankita Bhandari

tea.why: Protesters are demanding justice for Ankita Bhandari and protesting against the appointment of Dushyant Gautam as Sikkim Governor.
tea.want: Transparent, impartial investigations, accountability without political interference, and action regarding allegations.
tea.changed: Oct 18: NSUI held a candle march in Delhi led by Vinod Jakhar amid heavy police deployment.

summary: Organisations including the Congress Seva Dal and the National Students Union of India (NSUI) held separate candle marches in New Delhi to demand justice for Ankita Bhandari, who was murdered in Uttarakhand in 2022. The Seva Dal march proceeded from the Indian Youth Congress office on Raisina Road to the Jantar Mantar roundabout, while the NSUI march started from its national headquarters. Participants called for an impartial, time-bound investigation, accountability without political interference, and questioned the appointment of Dushyant Gautam as the Governor of Sikkim while an investigation involving allegations is ongoing. Seva Dal chief Srinivas B V and NSUI national president Vinod Jakhar addressed the gatherings, criticising government actions and demanding that influential individuals be held accountable under the law. The demonstrations follow earlier detentions of Bhandari's parents and several Congress leaders near India Gate.
demands: Impartial and time-bound investigation into the case
Address the concerns of Ankita Bhandari's family
response: Police deployed heavy personnel around the protest site during the NSUI demonstration, and police previously detained Bhandari's parents along with several Congress leaders near India Gate.

updates.text: Congress Seva Dal held a candle march from Raisina Road to Jantar Mantar demanding justice for Ankita Bhandari.
Bhandari's parents and several Congress leaders were detained while protesting near India Gate and later released.
NSUI took out a candle march in Delhi led by national president Vinod Jakhar amid heavy police deployment.
